title: 1948 and the abolition of the army: a country without an army
goal: Tell how Costa Rica abolished its army in 1948-1949 and correct a wrong reason, with no es que… sino que….
grammar: refuting a reason: no es que… sino que… (review)

sections.title: 1948 and the abolition of the army: a country without an army
body: In this lesson you read about the civil war of 1948 and the decision to abolish the army in Costa Rica. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for correcting a reason: *No es que… sino que…*.

items: I can correct a reason with *No es que… sino que…*.
I can tell what happened in Costa Rica in 1948 and 1949.
I can explain who guards Costa Rica without an army.
